from pocket_coffea.lib.cfg_manager import CfgManager
from omegaconf import OmegaConf
from pathlib import Path

# Step 1: Fetch the framework's default parameter set
cfg_manager = CfgManager()
default_params = cfg_manager.default_config

# Step 2: Load and overlay the YAML files
object_preselection = OmegaConf.load(Path("params/object_preselection.yaml"))
triggers = OmegaConf.load(Path("params/triggers.yaml"))

# Merge with YAML files overriding defaults (right-most has highest priority)
final_params = OmegaConf.merge(default_params, object_preselection, triggers)
